column1: # agent-env manifest. One row per line, fields separated by TAB:
#   kind   source (in this repo)   dest (under $HOME)   [platform: mac | linux | all, default all]
# kinds: file | tree | merge-json | merge-toml | link   (see README.md)
# After editing: commit, push, and let the nightly sync (or `estate-config-sync apply`) install it.
# Global instructions for each harness.
file
file
# The doctrine pack: Claude Code loads ~/.claude/rules/*.md by itself; Codex is told to read
# the same files from the doctrine directory. (Copied into home/doctrine/ when this repo was created.)
file
file
tree
# Settings the harnesses also write: only the keys in these fragments are managed.
merge-json
merge-toml
# The shell-footgun hook from agent-estate's guardrails module. `estate install config-sync` copies
# its fragments in when it creates this repo: the Claude one is merged into home/.claude/settings.json
# above, the Codex one is home/.codex/hooks.json. Hooks merge per command, so yours are kept.
# Codex skips an unreviewed hook: start Codex once, open /hooks and trust it.
merge-json
